prompt: Investigate whether retrieval augmentation improves this classifier, compare plausible mechanisms, run the most informative experiment, and state only the claim the evidence supports.

Rename this local variable and update its unit test; there is no failure, experiment, metric, or research claim involved.
Explain in general terms what a stack trace is for a beginner; I am not asking you to diagnose a real crash.
Correct the spelling and punctuation in this README paragraph; it contains no experimental result or statistical conclusion.
Summarize the introduction of this paper for me without evaluating its claims, reproducing its study, or writing our own result section.
